text: The Flood Protection Sector Project‑III (FPSP‑III) is a strategic initiative under Pakistan’s National Flood Protection Plan‑IV (NFPP‑IV), aimed at managing flood risks and enhancing river training across the country. It involves both structural and non-structural measures to mitigate flood impacts, including embankment strengthening, river training works, and upgrades to early warning systems. The project is coordinated by the Federal Flood Commission and implemented by Provincial Irrigation Departments, with support from various national and international partners.
